about.en: Adri is a Forrozeiro born in Recife, PE (Brazil). He started Forró Arrasta-pé in the traditional Quadrilhas Juninas in his elementary school. After joining UFPE (2000), he started dancing Pé-de-Serra in epic Recife's venues like Sala de Reboco and Forró da Kelly. Moving to Belo Horizonte (UFMG, 2005), he practiced Universitário, PD and Roots styles in venues like Ziriguidun, Recanto and Lapa before moving to Europe (2006), where he visited various venues and festivals in Germany, UK, Spain, Portugal and Austria. Since 2024, Adri has been teaching and organizing his themed Forró events in Vienna, then in Berlin (2025).

aboutShort.en: Adri grew up dancing forró arrasta-pé in his school's quadrilhas juninas in Recife. After Belo Horizonte and a move to Europe in 2006, he started teaching and organizing forró nights in Vienna in 2024, and in Berlin in 2025.
aboutShort.de: Adri tanzte als Kind Forró Arrasta-pé in den Quadrilhas Juninas seiner Schule in Recife. Nach Belo Horizonte und dem Umzug nach Europa 2006 begann er 2024 in Wien, 2025 in Berlin, Forró-Abende zu veranstalten und zu unterrichten.
aboutShort.pt: O Adri cresceu dançando forró arrasta-pé nas quadrilhas juninas da escola, em Recife. Depois de Belo Horizonte e da mudança para a Europa em 2006, começou a dar aulas e organizar noites de forró em Viena em 2024, e em Berlim em 2025.

description.en: Themed Forró nights in Berlin, on tour (Summer 2026: Vienna, Salzburg, Stuttgart, Saarbrücken, Berlin, Wroclaw) and on demand for weddings, anniversaries and company events.
Introduction to Forró culture, history, origins, instruments and regional influences. Essential dance principles, partner connection, etiquette and safety.
Fundamental rhythms: Arrasta-pé, Baião, Coco, Xaxado and Xote basic steps and movements.
Reinforcement of Forró rhythms, focusing on Coco and Xaxado.
Enhancement of base steps and new partner movements, such as loops and position switches.
Advanced syncopation, two-handed leading, complex turns and dynamic walks.
Exploration of dynamic base changes and side-way walks to add versatility to dance movements.
Advanced partner interactions, turns and pivots in Universitário style.

title.en: Level X: Hula-hoop with ribbon figure

description.en: Refining complex movements and the leader's inverted loops with waist leading.
Intricate partner dynamics, including back-and-forth L-shaped upward arm laces.
